title: Naturality of componentwise restriction-stalk maps
statement: For every component family with the restriction-stalk germ formula, each module morphism commutes with the component maps.

proof.text: Apply ModuleCat morphism extensionality and exists_germ_eq for the underlying abelian stalk to reduce to a germ over V. Unfold stalkAddMap, apply stalkFunctor_map_germ_apply on W, and use the assumed germ formulas for c G and c F. Apply stalkFunctor_map_germ_apply on X; the section map induced by restriction and slice-site equivalence is definitionally the ambient section map, so reflexivity closes the equality.

proof_origin.place: Sheaves Section 6.31, Lemma 6.31.1 (3); germ calculation formalized by the M1 second reader

lean.statement:
theorem moduleRestrictionStalk_components_natural (X : RingedSpace.{u}) (W : Opens X)
    (x : X) (hx : x ∈ W)
    (c : ∀ F : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X),
      (ModuleCat.restrictScalars
          (X.toPresheafedSpace.restrictStalkIso W.isOpenEmbedding ⟨x, hx⟩).inv.hom).obj
        ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor (X.restrict W.isOpenEmbedding) ⟨x, hx⟩).obj
          ((W.sheafOfModulesEquivOver (moduleRings X)).functor.obj
            ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor (moduleRings X) W).obj F))) ⟶
        (RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X x).obj F)
    (hc : ∀ (F : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X)) (V : Opens W)
        (hV : (⟨x, hx⟩ : W) ∈ V)
        (s : F.val.obj (op (W.isOpenEmbedding.isOpenMap.functor.obj V))),
        (c F) (TopCat.Presheaf.germ (C := Ab.{u})
          (X := (X.restrict W.isOpenEmbedding).carrier)
          ((W.sheafOfModulesEquivOver (moduleRings X)).functor.obj
            ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor (moduleRings X) W).obj F)).val.presheaf
          V ⟨x, hx⟩ hV s) =
        TopCat.Presheaf.germ (C := Ab.{u}) (X := X.carrier) F.val.presheaf
          (W.isOpenEmbedding.isOpenMap.functor.obj V) x ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, hV, rfl⟩ s) :
    ∀ {F G : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X)} (f : F ⟶ G),
      (ModuleCat.restrictScalars
          (X.toPresheafedSpace.restrictStalkIso W.isOpenEmbedding ⟨x, hx⟩).inv.hom).map
        ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor (X.restrict W.isOpenEmbedding) ⟨x, hx⟩).map
          ((W.sheafOfModulesEquivOver (moduleRings X)).functor.map
            ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor (moduleRings X) W).map f))) ≫
        c G =
      (c F) ≫ (RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X x).map f

mathlib_searches.query: A family of module stalk maps specified on germs commutes with the maps induced by morphisms of sheaves
The stalk of a module sheaf restricted to an open subspace agrees with its original stalk, compatibly with the stalk ring action
mathlib_searches.verdict: No exact specialized module restriction comparison or assumed-germ-formula naturality theorem. Generic stalk and germ lemmas are used in the naturality proof; scheme Tilde results do not apply to arbitrary ringed spaces.
